setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with profile.json (an admin or a user with the Recruiter, People Manager and Asset Manager roles) and profile.<seller>.json (a user without HR roles). A Draft vacancy <vacancy>; a candidate <candidate> (an alias of the tester's mailbox) with one application to <vacancy> in Screening; a user <employee> who holds the asset <asset>. Every candidate e-mail must be the tester's own mailbox or an alias of it.

evals.prompt: Publica una vacante de asesor comercial en Bogotá, tiempo completo, presencial, 2 cupos, responsable <recruiter e-mail>. No mostrar salario.
evals.expected_output: Previews a vacancy plan (Draft), stops; after the yes creates it, then previews a publish plan that names the public page, the careers list and the acknowledgement e-mails to applicants, stops; after the second yes publishes and gives the public link.
expectations: Uses scripts/recruitment.js preview with kind vacancy, then kind publish; no hand-made POST to vacancy or form
The description is plain text (no HTML) and salaryRange.visible stays false
Says the page is public without sign-in and how to close it (close plan turns the form off)
Writes nothing before each yes; applies with --version and --confirmed

evals.prompt: ¿Qué candidatos tiene la vacante <vacancy> y en qué etapa va cada uno?
evals.expected_output: Runs pipeline and answers with names and stages (and counts), without e-mails, salaries, CVs or cover letters; writes nothing.
expectations: Lists names and stages only; no e-mail addresses, salary figures or CV links in the answer

evals.prompt: Rechaza a <candidate> de la vacante <vacancy>, no tiene la experiencia.
evals.expected_output: Previews a move plan to rejected with reason experience_mismatch, warns that the candidate receives a rejection e-mail, stops; after the yes applies with --reaches-people and reads back.
expectations: Uses preview with kind move, stage rejected and a rejection reason
Tells the user plainly that the candidate gets an e-mail and asks for a yes to that
Does not use the bulk stage route or a hand-made PATCH

evals.prompt: Agenda entrevista con <candidate> el jueves a las 3 con <interviewer e-mail> por Meet.
evals.expected_output: Asks for the missing details it cannot assume (time zone or confirms the account's, duration, meeting link), then previews an interview plan with a date carrying its offset, says nobody is notified and no calendar invite is created, stops.
expectations: Does not guess the time zone silently: asks or states the one it uses and why
The plan's startDate and endDate carry a UTC offset
Says the interview sends no invitation or e-mail and the user must invite people from their calendar

evals.prompt: Con el perfil <seller>: registra la devolución del portátil <asset> de <employee>.
evals.expected_output: Runs the script with --profile <seller>, gets a 403, says plainly that this user has no permission for assets and an admin must give the role; does not retry with another profile or another route.
expectations: Stops at the 403 and explains it in plain words
Does not switch to profile.json, call the check-in route or try any other way
